fields.description: Issue features prominent coverage of South Florida oil development, including photographs and reporting on the Sunniland (Standard Oil) field and claims that production is being held down due to a shortage of pipe. Editorial and political reporting discusses a critical Miami Beach election and candidate motives. Major investigative/polemical articles focus on suspended Miami police lieutenant C. O. Huttoe, allegations of framing and corruption, and related legal and political implications involving the Jacobson divorce case and Judge Ross Williams. Additional local columns cover municipal court items, juvenile theft cases, consumer/contract credit issues, and civic campaign notes.
